editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 25 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.

editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Test whether a superseded approval can still receive an answer
dailyInsight.insight: Cline's fresh session-lifecycle fix supports one bounded test for teams that let users edit, restart, or switch agent work: replace a run while a tool approval is pending, then verify the old request is explicitly denied and cannot consume the replacement run's reply.
dailyInsight.mechanism: Cline clears pending interactions before starting an edited replacement session. Its interaction coordinator resolves a pending question so the outgoing run can unwind and resolves a pending tool approval as denied while recording the lifecycle reason. The merged pull request identifies the previous failure mode as a parked resolver that could intercept later answers.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: An approval is a decision attached to a particular execution context, not a durable UI ornament. If superseded work can keep a pending resolver, an operator may see a new conversation while an old run remains suspended or receives the next answer. A disposable lifecycle drill can expose that mismatch before it becomes a support or control failure.

actions.audience: Builder or operator of an agent client with editable conversations or task switching
actions.label: Run one superseded-approval drill
actions.instruction: In a disposable workspace, pause a tool request for approval, edit or restart the originating prompt without answering it, then send an answer to the replacement run. Confirm that the old approval receives an explicit denied or cancelled result, its task unwinds, and the new run alone receives the later answer. Keep the test free of production credentials and destructive tools.

receipts.title: fix(vscode): settle pending tool approval when a message edit replaces the session (#12836)
receipts.supports: Documents the reproducible edit-with-pending-approval failure, the stale resolver consequence, and the change that clears pending interactions before the replacement session starts.

receipts.title: fix(vscode): settle pending tool approval when a message edit replaces the session (#12836)
receipts.supports: Shows the source-level lifecycle change and the coordinator implementation that resolves pending tool approvals as denied.

confidence.basis: A fresh merged Cline pull request, its linked commit, the coordinator source, and an existing focused interaction test agree on the terminal behavior of pending approvals.

dailyInsight.limitation: These are public source receipts from Cline's VS Code path. They do not establish a released extension version, behavior in every client or provider, or that all interruption paths have end-to-end regression coverage.
dailyInsight.falsifier: Revise this call if a public regression shows an edited or superseded Cline session retaining a resolver that can accept a later reply, if the implementation intentionally preserves a pending approval across replacement sessions, or if an end-to-end test reveals another lifecycle path that bypasses cleanup.
dailyInsight.watchNext: Watch for an end-to-end edit-and-regenerate regression that creates a real tool prompt, supersedes it, and proves that the replacement session alone owns subsequent input.
